title: Document unit-test and grouped-test-case modeling
objective: Clarify the test-strategy and implementation schemas for one-test-case/one-unit-test mappings and grouped test cases, remove the package-version smoke test, and release revision 0.6.2.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository is already on main and this backward-compatible schema documentation change does not require a context branch.

request.text: Update the test case schema documentation to explicitly support a legitimate one-test-case/one-unit-test mapping with procedure steps and an implementation selector, while also documenting grouped test cases and executions. Remove the package version smoke test, commit the change, and release a revision bump.

scope.name: unit-test-case-documentation
scope.description: Document unit test cases whose procedure steps describe the actions of one independently traceable unit-test function.
scope.reason: The schema supports unit tests but did not explicitly explain this useful one-to-one mapping.

scope.name: grouped-test-case-documentation
scope.description: Document grouped test scenarios and executions that cover multiple test cases without imposing a cardinality rule.
scope.reason: The data model legitimately permits grouped cases and grouped command executions.

scope.name: release-and-test-cleanup
scope.description: Remove the package version smoke test and bump the package revision to 0.6.2.
scope.reason: The version test is not part of the requested schema behavior and the documentation change is revision-level.

nonGoals.name: schema-version-change
nonGoals.description: Do not change the task-test-strategy schema $id or introduce a new major/minor contract version.
nonGoals.reason: This is a backward-compatible documentation and example clarification.

nonGoals.name: test-cardinality-enforcement
nonGoals.description: Do not enforce one-test-case/one-unit-test as a validation rule.
nonGoals.reason: The grouped use case is legitimate and must remain representable.

nonGoals.name: external-publication
nonGoals.description: Do not create a Git tag, publish a package, or push remote branches.
nonGoals.reason: The release is a local revision release consistent with the latest repository convention.

items.name: unit-test-case-shape
items.description: The test-strategy schema must document unit test cases whose procedure steps describe one independently traceable unit-test function.
items.reason: Consumers need an explicit unit-test interpretation of type=unit and procedure.steps.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The canonical and inline TestCase definitions describe the one-test-case/one-unit-test use case and include a named unit-test example with Arrange, Act, and Assert steps.

items.name: grouped-test-case-shape
items.description: The schemas must state that grouped cases and grouped executions are valid and that one-to-one cardinality is not enforced.
items.reason: The same data structure must support both focused unit tests and grouped scenarios.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Test-case and implementation descriptions state that one execution may cover multiple cases and that the schema does not require one-to-one mapping.

items.name: version-test-removal
items.description: The package version smoke test must be removed from the CLI test suite while existing version behavior remains available.
items.reason: The version smoke test is not needed for this schema documentation change.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The package-version test case is absent and the remaining test suite passes.

items.name: revision-release
items.description: After implementation and validation pass, increment the package revision from 0.6.1 to 0.6.2.
items.reason: The user requested a revision bump for the backward-compatible documentation change.

acceptanceCriteria.description: package.json reports 0.6.2 and the changed schema examples validate.

items.name: task-commit-gates
items.description: Implementation, validation, and delivery task records must capture the change and its local evidence.
items.reason: The repository records schema changes and revision releases through traceable task envelopes.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The complete WI-0030 object tree validates with no findings attributable to this change.
